title: Length of Wanderlane Traveller Club Membership and the Carry Uplift on Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
A traveller's standing in the Wanderlane Traveller Club bears on the value standing for a carry forward onto a fresh travel credit voucher under Air Ticket Fare Brands. Two things are read from the club record and nothing else: the card held on the traveller's profile, with its tier and whether it stands active, and the date that card was enrolled. Membership length is counted in whole calendar months from the enrolment date to the handling date, and the long-membership term is 60 months.

| Card on the traveller's profile | Membership length | Uplift added to the value standing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Active card of the Platinum, Titanium or Ambassador tiers | At or beyond 60 months | 0.10 is added to the value standing |
| Active card of the Blue, Silver or Gold tiers | At or beyond 60 months | 0.06 is added to the value standing |
| Active card of any tier | Within 60 months | 0.02 is added to the value standing |
| No active card of any of those tiers | Immaterial | No card uplift is added to the value standing |

**Both sides of the long-membership term.** An active Ambassador card enrolled exactly 60 months before the handling date stands at the term, and the uplift added to the value standing is 0.10; the same card enrolled 59 months before that date stands within the term, and the uplift added to the value standing is 0.02. An active Silver card enrolled 72 months before the handling date carries an uplift of 0.06 added to the value standing, while an active Silver card enrolled 12 months before that date carries an uplift of 0.02 added to the value standing. Where the traveller holds no active club card of any tier, no card uplift is added to the value standing.
